The '''Vilosoria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vilosoria]].
